integrity.method: mathematical proof supplemented by reproducible finite arithmetic tests

scientific_limitations: Global minimax attainment of the optimized schedule requires each computed normalized step at most 3/2.
Fixed deterministic iteration horizon and known positive per-step conditional variance bounds; no data-dependent steps, momentum or joint mini-batch allocation.
The sharp performance upper certificate uses the published smooth-convex interpolation argument; its weighted use and the optimizer are derived here.
No independent audit or exhaustive historical-priority certification.
title: Exact minimax SGD schedules with heterogeneous oracle noise and a sharp step-order reversal criterion
